ic_device.name: INA128/INA129
ic_device.description: Low-power, general-purpose instrumentation amplifiers with excellent accuracy, versatile three-op-amp design, and single external resistor gain setting from 1 to 10,000.

pins.name: RG
pins.description: Gain setting pin. For gains greater than 1, place a gain resistor between pin 1 and pin 8.
pins.evidence: Gain setting pin. For gains greater than 1, place a gain resistor between pin 1 and pin 8.

pins.name: REF
pins.description: Reference input. This pin must be driven by low impedance or connected to ground.
pins.evidence: Reference input. This pin must be driven by low impedance or connected to ground.

port_dependencies.condition: Reference input driven by low impedance
Gain resistor placed between pin 1 and pin 8 for G > 1
